name: Player Query: synchronous SBO lookup error
description: The provider returns a nonzero business error during synchronous lookup. Earning catches the exception; the Player response and unchanged wallet are recorded.

queries.name: user_wallets
queries.sql: SELECT id, platform_id, balance, freeze, player_id FROM wallets WHERE user_id = 1 ORDER BY id

queries.name: sbo_player
queries.sql: SELECT id, account, vendor_player_id, playing FROM players WHERE station_id = 1 AND platform_id = 3 AND user_id = 1

queries.name: user_transactions
queries.sql: SELECT id, wallet_id, balance_original, balance_variable, balance_complete, trade_type FROM transactions WHERE user_id = 1 ORDER BY id
